title: Classify Decisions by Impact and Reversibility
decision: Introduce decision tiers and reversibility semantics to distinguish ordinary decisions from costly and irreversible ones.
context: Without explicit tiering, DMP risks either overuse or underuse, reducing its effectiveness.
rationale: Decision memory is most valuable when forgetting is dangerous. Tiering clarifies when DMP is required.
consequences: Teams gain a shared understanding of which decisions demand durable memory and review.
